title: How Humans and LLMs Read Gender into “Gender-Neutral” Physical Descriptions

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting zero-shot ratings (on a 1-7 scale) from LLMs on how strongly isolated physical attributes are associated with women, men, and non-binary individuals, comparing these predictions to human baseline ratings using Pearson correlation and RMSE, and analyzing asymmetric model abstention/refusal rates across the different gender categories.
